instructions: You will need a non stick frying pan. Cube the cheese into fine pieces the size of an egg. Add all the spices, mix well, and cover it with water. This is important to put the cheese in relatively small pieces, about 1 cm or less, so that it doesn't melt in boiling water. Stir every time you see your water rising to the surface. The water level should be about 3/4 inch above the edges. Cover and sweat the cheese over medium heat to your desired texture. When it is fairly hard, you should begin testing a ball with your pointer finger or the tip of your pointer finger. It should not crack, or have tiny lumps of the cheese floating around the circumference. If that does, remove your pot from the burner and add the cheese in small pieces back into the cheese water. You can use a blender to do this. After 10minutes, check temperature, if it cracks, it is ready to be used in a recipe. If it cracks again, remove it from the heat and pour off any excess water. It should be fairly thick and smooth. Take a handful of cheese balls and roll them around the kool aid until each one starts to crack. You will have balls that are about as big and round as any bagels, but you might need to work fast to get the balls to crack so that the cheese balls crack. When you are ready, remove the balls with a slotted spoon, and set aside in an airtight container. These go rancherized and keep in airtight jars for up to 2 years. At your next party, you will need to pick up a dozen or more colourful cheese pieces or a few smaller ones or simply buy the big ones already on sale. These can be frozen and stored in the freezer for use later. They keep well in the freezer.

I usually keep the pan on a low heat so i add the rolls a few at a time. Once i have put the patties in to a plastic bag, i remove the bag and tip out a little of the oil, then i fry the patties in batches in the oil as you fry them until nicely browned and crispy. These will take about 10 minutes, depending on your grill or ovens. As always, keep an eye on them. If they brown too quickly, place them in a plastic bag and store in the fridge to prevent burning. Once your cooked, remove from the bag and place on a paper towel covered plate to dry. You want to be as close to room temp as possible, while the temperature goes. Use a large plate such as a cookie sheet as a non stick one that goes in the oven on a slow heat. If you have a stove top grill such as my unit, remove it when your ready to add the patties. Keep doing this until you have put everything together and put everything in the oven on a medium. Keep on keeping turning the patties, as the oven does the trick. Add the sweet chilli's to the pan that the patties were cooked in and keep frying on a very slow heat until they are lightly golden, about 10 mins each side.

Using your hands, remove tapenade from the bowl and place on a flat surface or tray.  Break up any lumps with the blade of a knife and gently press them through the funnel of your food processor. Note, make sure you don't get any dough stuck to your fingers or your hands since they are delicate. For extra air, roll the balls with your hands. For softer and faster results, roll them on a pastry cloth soaked in cold water before rolling them into balls of desired size. If you have the time, you can roll them on a greased cooking sheet until all of the balls have been rolled and refrigerated or frozen. For more dough you may use all of the dough. Roll mixture into balls and put them on the sprayed parchment paper and then freeze. When ready to use, take out and dip each ball into melted caramel on low heat and bake on a baking sheet or tortilla coated with cooking spray for 5 - 10 minutes until crispy. The only time i made these i did not miss it and they seemed the best in my kitchen. Some even liked them with a little sugar. Note, you may use flour, cornmeal or a combination to roll the balls, but it will not taste right to stretch with fingers, so if using cornmeal, just mix a bit more. I prefer flour, but a few tablespoons or so of water in a measuring cup helps to measure out the cornmeal you should probably be able to get away with 1 cups of cornmeal or 4 ounces of flour. Note, the best way to measure out the cornmeal is to look at a 1/4 cup measuring cup, which is about 2 tablespoons/4 ounce in weight.

title: Cotija and Longanero Salt Body Polish
ingredients: 4 pieces aluminum foil packed in salt | 1/4 cup grated cotija cheese
instructions: Place the piece of aluminum foil on your work surface or on the counter. Carefully pack the piece of aluminum foil into about 6 to 12 ounces of liquid, about a 1/8 inch square. You want all of your sheets and your hands to be able to fit into your vacuum flask so tightly packed it will slip out easily. Be sure to take out the air bubbles and circulate the liquid around you. The foil should enclose the air. You could leave it on the counter at room temperature for up to one week before simply giving it as a gift. Place the jar of liquid into a deep, cool place such as the bottom of a small tea kettle to keep hot. To prepare the body, place the piece of aluminum foil that you are using into the liquid and allow it to come to room temperature. Carefully transfer the piece of aluminum foil into the liquid and set it onto the counter with the flat of your finger to remove any liquid that leaks out. Carefully remove the piece of aluminum foil in a single layer with the flat of your hand. Carefully transfer the piece of tin foil with the liquid onto the piece of aluminum foil. You should have 12 pieces of aluminium foil layered on top of each other. Using a tooth pick, poke at each piece of aluminum foil that has been dipped into water, just enough to make a hole in each piece of foil. Carefully remove the pieces with a pair of toothpicks with the tooth picks. Continue to do this until all the pieces are used. To use the liquid in the liquid, you can take one piece of aluminum foil and coat it lightly with pam, place on your working surface, and allow to reach room temperature before you start working it. It just means you are working the residue from another piece of aluminum foil into the liquid by pouring it all over the piece of aluminum that has been coated with pam. After working the residue carefully take your piece of aluminum onto the counter, and apply the residue evenly into a hole in each piece of aluminum foil. Carefully push the piece of aluminum foil with the residue onto the piece of aluminum that has been covered with pam, pressing down on the residue with your fingers to extract more of the liquid. Carefully push the piece of aluminum with the residue back onto the piece of aluminum foil. The residue will begin to air circulate around the piece of aluminum foil. Do not add any more air or you will end up with large air pockets. This is normal. Use your hands to flatten each piece of aluminum foil into a thin slab using your hands. Make sure the air bubbles are between every piece of aluminum foil. Wrap the piece of foil tightly around the fatty pieces of aluminum foil with the palm of your hand to make a seal on the foil. This is a heavy piece of aluminum that has been slightly flattened but doesn't stick to your hands. Place the piece of foil over the weight in the microwave and microwave on high power power for 1 1/2 minutes, rotating your microwave so the aluminum is evenly and evenly covered with its liquid. Check the piece of aluminum at 1 1/2 minutes, and if it begins to bubble up and crackles all over it is done. The tighter you move, the more crispy the piece will be. Remove the paper from the microwave and serve immediately. Store sealed in the refrigerator, and it will keep for up to 2 months.

title: Almagro
ingredients: 2 cups cake flour | 1 tablespoon instant cognac ( to taste ) | 1/2 teaspoon oregano
instructions: Preheat oven on the convection setting on your oven's lowest setting. Measure the dry ingredients into a bowl and whisk vigorously with a fork. Use your hands to incorporate the creams. Pour the dry ingredients quickly into a larger bowl the mix will become difficult to stir. Turn off the convection setting. Do not stir, just shake the bowl a bit until the moist dough forms. Sprinkle the dough evenly, if necessary. Form the dough into a round flat disc about 1/8 inch thick. Place the dough on an ungreased baking sheet, pressing down slightly to make sure it is flat. Bake at 325f for about 55 minutes, or until the top has a nice golden brown color. Cool on a rack. Remove the crust, and place on a cutting board. Let cool. Remove the hard edges with a knife. Cover with plastic wrap. Cut into squares with a serrated knife. The easiest way to cut in your knife is with a very sharp knife in the center, but if it does not cut in half horizontally to the opposite, you have cut the square into pieces with your knife. Do not cut horizontally. Remove the plastic wrap. Cut the squares into smaller squares.

instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a small sauce pan. Add to sauce pan on low heat and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool before using. Keep refrigerated.

title: Cantonese Beef Sandwiches
ingredients: 1 lemon, juice and zest of | 2 tablespoons light dark sesame oil | 1/8 teaspoon chili paste | 1 lb thinly sliced lean ground sirloin steak or 1 lb round steak | 1 jar spaghetti sauce or ( 8 ounce ) jar taco sauce | 1 can frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed ( thawed, undiluted ) | 8 slices of thin crusty italian bread, toasted
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the first five ingredients.

title: Rustic Thin Crust Pizza Base
ingredients: 300 g whole wheat flour | 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano | 410 g crushed tomatoes in puree
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and press into a well oiled 20x28cm tin or large, flat base tin. Cut a cross into the mixture and bake in a medium size slow oven for 10 - 15 minutes until browned. Cut into squares and serve with pizza sauce or plain breads.

title: Simple Snow Peas Curry
ingredients: 1/2 lb snow peas, ends snapped off and cut up | 1/4 teaspoon ginger-garlic paste | 1 teaspoon crushed turmeric ( or to taste )
instructions: Combine all ingredients and saute for a couple minutes. Serve.

title: Barley Barley
ingredients: 1 tablespoon liquid smoke | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar | 1/4 cup pearl barley
instructions: Combine all ingredients and stir well. Serve cold.

title: Black-Eyed Peas
ingredients: 3 -4 cups black-eyed peas ( canned are ok ) | 2 beef bouillon cubes ( or equivalent amount in a packet ) | 1 teaspoon minced ginger
instructions: In saucepan, add all ingredients, stir.

title: Black Olive Tapenade for Fish or Chicken
ingredients: 14 ounces black olives, pitted | 3 ounces parsley, fresh chopped
instructions: Place all ingredients in food processor and pulse a few times until mixture is desired consistency.

title: Homemade Vietnamese Seasoning Mix
ingredients: 1 cup soya sauce ( kikkoman is the best for me ) | 1 tablespoons chicken bouillon powder ( optional )
instructions: In a glass jar with a tight fitting lid, put all the ingredients.

title: Pumpkin Spaghetti
ingredients: 4 cans pumpkin | 1 jar spaghetti sauce | 2 tablespoons coriander powder ( or use chilli powder ) | 1 tablespoon ground thyme ( or other herb of your choice ) | 1 orange peel ( thinly shaved or coarsely chopped ) ( optional )
instructions: If using squash, cut into bite sized pieces and place in microwave safe bowl. Pierce squash in small bits with a fork or skewer.

title: Olive Garden Mediterranean Salmon and Shrimp Salad
ingredients: 14 ounces frozen shrimp, defrosted and cleaned | 12 ounces frozen mussels, defrosted and cleaned | 14 ounces frozen cleaned scallops ( sea bass or shrimp ) | 16 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved | 1 teaspoon anise seed | 1 dash bottled hot pepper sauce | 2/3 cup couscous, cooked and cooled | crisco ( optional )
instructions: Put shrimp through food processor or blender. Add remaining ingredients and pulse until well mixed and smooth, approximately 15 seconds. Pour onto serving plate, cover and chill for 30 minutes to blend flavors. Garnish with some grated romano cheese if desired.

title: Rice With Noodles & Cauliflower
ingredients: 8 ounces noodles, cooked | 8 ounces cauliflower, cut into florets | 4 ounces mozzarella cheese, cut into 1/4 inch slices | 2 teaspoons mustard, dijon | 1/2 tablespoon ground sumac | 1/4 cup flat leaf parsley, chopped | 1/4 cup niter kefalotiri or 1/4 cup greek kefalotiri ( may sub fresh flat-leaf parsley ) | 1 1/2 quarts cold water
instructions: Mix the ingredients together in a large, heavy soup kettle or dutch oven, making sure it is heated to a boil.. Cook the noodles until tender and drained. Toss with the remaining ingredients. Serve hot.

title: Ole! Bayou-Style Green Olive Tapenade
ingredients: 1/2 cup green olives | 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar ( or white wine vinegar-you can use red wine vinegar just not vinegar ) | 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice i did it | 2 teaspoons lime juice | 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder ( or to taste ) | 1/4 teaspoon celery salt ( or to taste ) | 1 teaspoon quick-cooking oil
instructions: Blend all ingredients well. Serve with hot, crusty bread. You can also use olive tapenade.

title: Lebanese Barley Cookies (Aglio)
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups barley flour | 4 teaspoons vanilla sugar | 1 teaspoon chili, ground
instructions: Place all the ingredients in the bowl. Using the kneading action on a clean flat surface, roll the dough lightly. Cut into 1 - 2 inch circles. Put on an un greased tray and leave to rest on the tray in a warm room, to rise. You will need to cook the cookies in batches or they may crackle and flatten. The cookies are ready when the top cracks and is firm. Place in an airtight container and store in the fridge.

title: Beef Barley Vegetable Pilaf
ingredients: 2 cans beef broth | pearl barley | diced carrot
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot on high setting and stir. Cook 6 hours on high or 5 hours on low. Stir.

instructions: Spray a dutch oven with cooking spray over high heat.

title: Beer and Pilsner
ingredients: 1 bottle pitman's beer with corona ( corona ) | 10 peppers
instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve.

ingredients: 2 lbs string beans, trimmed, snapped at 1-inch intervals and soaked overnight in cold water | 2 1/2 lbs ham knuckles, cut crosswise into 1-inch lengths | 1/4 cup sun-dried tomato packed in oil, drained, lightly chopped | 1/4 cup nonfat dry milk powder | 1/8 cup heavy cream | 1/8 cup saffron | 2 cups fresh green grapes
instructions: Place the ham shkaifters in a large nonstick skillet and add enough water to cover them by 1/2 inch.

title: Tofu and Baked Bean Soup
ingredients: 1/2 lb ground beef | 1 can baked beans | 0.5 can cream of mushroom soup | 7/8 cup chicken stock | 1 tablespoon capers | 1 loaf white bread, sliced | 1 package firm tofu
instructions: Brown ground beef. Add all other ingredients. Simmer for 20 minutes.

title: Crunchy Beef Salad
ingredients: 2/3 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into thin strips | 3 tablespoons fish sauce | 1 teaspoon low sodium taco seasoning | 2 teaspoons canola oil | 1 teaspoon sugar | 7 cups torn bibb lettuce | 1 package fresh pasta, cooked | 1 cup shredded gruyere cheese
instructions: Heat a large nonstick skillet. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper. Add beef.

title: Slow Cooker Poached Hominy
ingredients: 2 cans stewed tomatoes with juice, undrained | 1 can hominy, rinsed and drained | 2/3 cup maple syrup | 1/4 cup apple cider
instructions: In 4 - 6 1/2 to 5 quart slow cooker combine the first seven ingredients. Cover, and cook on low for 5 - 6 hours, or on high for 5 1/2 to 6 hours.

title: Tex-Mex Spicy Spinach Dip
ingredients: 10 fresh sausages | 1 package frozen whipped topping, thawed | 1 package linguine | 1 package shredded cottage cheese | 8 fresh caciocavito chilies, sliced, divided | 1 teaspoon minced dried ancho chilies | 1 1/2 tablespoons taco sauce | 1 1/2 teaspoons confectioners' sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 450 degrees f. Cut sausages into 1/2 inch slices. Reserve 1 slice of sausages and cut remaining slices in half. Transfer slices to a resealable plastic bag. Remove air from bag, seal, and refrigerate about 30 minutes, or up to 1 day. Slice pasta in half lengthwise. Reserve 1 cup spaghetti cooking liquid.
